# SDI_STDP_Bond

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A synaptic plasticity mechanism combining Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity (STDP) with Structural Dynamic Interconnect (SDI) rules to adapt neuromorphic connections in real time. This bond enables in-network learning and self-organization, which is critical for iNEST systems to achieve brain-like adaptability without external supervision.
